title: 2019 Panini Prizm #281 Warren Moon Houston Oilers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019 Panini Prizm trading card features Warren Moon, a former quarterback of the Houston Oilers in the National Football League (NFL). The card measures 3½" x 2½" and is an original, licensed reprint. It is a part of the 2019 Panini Prizm set and has the card number 281. 

The card is in excellent condition and is perfect for any football or Warren Moon fan to add to their collection. The card has not been autographed and is unsigned. It is a parallel/variety Prizm card with English language text. This 2019 Panini Prizm Warren Moon #281 NFL Football Houston Oilers trading card was manufactured by Panini in the United States.
